title: Yannai, son of Rabbi Ami
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Chullin 111a, Rabbi Zerika said to Rav Safra, “Yannai, son of Rabbi Ami, and I came to the house of Yehudah, son of Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi,” etc.

notes.text: The consulted Chullin paragraph describes someone addressing Rabbi Zerika, whereas Hyman says Zerika addressed Rav Safra. His wording is retained as a source question. The paragraph spells out Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi.

The saved whole Davidson Chullin110b paragraph has Abaye send Rav Safra to inquire and Safra find Rav Zerika, whose first-person reply follows. The whole111a paragraph continues the visit to Rabbi Zerika and his first-person report of visiting with Yannai son of Rabbi Ami. This connected context supports Hyman’s Zerika-to-Safra reporting direction; the earlier isolated111a reversal objection is withdrawn here, not treated as source history. The named111a explicitly expands Rabbi Ami and Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi. The Rav/Rabbi Zerika title difference between110b and111a is disclosed, not harmonized. Hold classification is retained pending a separate clearance gate.

The printed notice spans both columns of Hyman’s p. 765. In Chullin 110b, Rav Safra visits Zerika, returns to Abaye, and receives a clarification. Chullin 111a continues that exchange before Safra’s second visit, when Zerika recounts the visit with Yannai. This sequence supports Hyman’s attribution of the reply to Zerika.
